children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Mukul M, Harsha Thota, Samarpith Rout, Charan Kumar, Pavan Kalyan, Revanth Babu Raavi
Sigmainfo: Magesh R, Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury, Divya Mishra
Agenda
Learn your feedback and update on evaluation
Discuss next steps about your timelines and purchase interest
Key Takeaways
Metrics improvements were highlighted as traffic, sessions, and qualified lead counts increased compared to the previous week.
An execution plan along with an action tracker for the ecom niche in ANZ is to be documented and shared after the call.
Innovative ideas to boost site indexing via LLM platforms were discussed, including implementing a Bing instant indexing plugin and creating an LLM.txt file.
Recommendations were made to enhance content credibility by assigning expert authorship and integrating detailed author profiles to boost EAT signals.
It was decided to incorporate these metrics and content improvements in upcoming monthly reports, including a dedicated GU and AU overview section.
Business Need
Improve search traffic metrics including increased overall users, sessions, and qualified leads from targeted content.
Document detailed lead requirements for ecommerce and investment sectors to align blog content with user pain points.
Strengthen SEO via technology update posts, Bing index plugin, and LLM TXT file integration.
Enhance content authority by incorporating expert author profiles and social links in blogs.
Impact
Metrics show increased overall users, sessions, and conversion potential with 2 leads initially and later 6-7 leads discussed.
Noted a traffic spike from the Salesforce release note with 100 keywords ranking and improved qualified lead generation.
Feature Mention
Refresh old content using Bing index plugin and LLM TXT file integration, and employ query file methods for targeted keyword strategies.
Plan to integrate a Charge GPT CTA within blogs to boost indexing frequency via user-initiated prompts.
Propose adding author expert profiles with social media links to bolster EAT signals and content credibility.
Team Size
Competitor
Budget
Decision Making
Harsha Thota and Revanth Babu lead decisions on SEO strategy and lead qualification, directing tactical implementations.
Commitment to share execution plans (e.g., ANZ ecommerce niche) and detailed documents post-call.
Timeline
Keyword integration data set to be shared by end of the week.
Monthly report to include dedicated section for GEO-specific service overviews (e.g., GU and AU).
Revised blog topics expected by end of day with feedback to be incorporated promptly.
Risk
Risk of users leaving the page if the Charge GPT CTA diverts them away, affecting on-page engagement.
Low crawling frequency by LLM platforms poses a risk to timely indexing of new content.
Positive Moment
Significant traffic spike from Salesforce release note and achievement of 100 keyword rankings were acknowledged as positive outcomes.
Recognition of increased qualified lead numbers and overall improved user sessions boosted team morale.
Pain Point
Need for better clarity on lead requirements to enhance content relevance and address client pain points effectively.
There is a concern about the effectiveness of including names of marketing, delivery, or leadership personnel in articles when they have limited time to read multiple articles.
Action Item
to: Shiresha Madhury
Finalize and share the revised blog titles for January 2026 topic proposals by end of day.
Harsha Thota

Create a document detailing the implementation plan for expert author profiles (EAT signals) for blogs, including a compiled list of potential experts in ecom, fintech, and related services, and share it with the team for internal discussion.
Revanth Babu Raavi
Share the execution plan for the ecom niche for ANZ, including estimates, responses, and priorities, with Shiresha.
Share the MOM (minutes of meeting) after the call with attached sources and the in-progress keyword data.
Create a document outlining the LLM visibility strategy, including keyword targeting per service and prompts for AOGO, and share it after the call.
Reshare the previously created query fan out (ANZ) document by sending the folder link to Shiresha.
Include the curated report on AOGO prompts as a separate section in the monthly report covering all service-related efforts.
Sandeep Phophaliya
Monitor and track lead conversion closely, ensuring that the feedback loop regarding increasing leads is maintained and communicated properly.
Follow up
Lead Qualification Process
Confirmed only qualified leads progressing to discovery calls are recorded; a document detailing leads' pain points is being prepared.
Content Enhancement Ideas
Proposed integrating chargeability and perplexity features in blogs to drive user engagement and indexing signals.
Content Authoring Strategy
Advised assigning expert authors with verifiable social profiles to boost EAT signals and content credibility in blogs.
Crawling Frequency Improvement
Discussed using CTA prompts that trigger interactions (e.g., charge GPT) to increase website crawling frequency on LLM platforms.
